notes.title: The Beta Workshop And Museum Update
notes.notes: [p]Hey chasers![/p][p][/p][p]These features are in beta, so they are not finished. Report any bugs to the Discord server.[/p][p][/p][p]We here at Foxnova Studios have some [b]very[/b] exciting information for you guys. We are thrilled to announce that we have just released a level maker that is, in our opinion, ten times better than the previous one. The reason we think this is because of the Steam Workshop. Some of you may be familiar with the Steam Workshop, and some of you may not. If you aren't, the Steam Workshop is a marketplace where users can publish custom levels, models, mods, etcetera. Alterchase now has this feature. The old level maker is now replaced with the new one. Users that play Alterchase can build levels with the given assets. When they are finished they can publish the level with the big blue "Publish" button in the top right corner. We have also added a museum map to showcase the creation of Alterchase. In this museum map, you have a camera. When you press the "C" key on your keyboard, it will take a Steam screenshot from the camera's POV. If you like this feature and would like it to be added to the game, please say so on the Alterchase Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]Now for the boring change notes:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added new level maker with new UI[/p][/*][*][p]Added three social media buttons on the main menu UI[/p][/*][*][p]Added credits button in main menu UI[/p][/*][*][p]Added credits[/p][/*][*][p]Added Steam Workshop page[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Steam Store page[/p][/*][*][p]Removed old level maker[/p][/*][*][p]Added museum map[/p][/*][*][p]Added camera[/p][/*][*][p]Added extras menu UI[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Now for the boring patch notes:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed wall glitch in arena[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed level loader ship not loading to the next level[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed speed glitch[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed falling outside of the death trigger[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing. We hope to see what [b]INSANELY[/b] cool levels you guys come up with![/p][p]      -  The Foxnova Team[/p]
